title: Looking for consultants to help expand an app
text: I’m looking for a group of consultants to help greatly expand on an app that’s already been built. Here’s the background - I can provide more information as needed. I built and continue to maintain (and add features to) an app on Bubble for a large non-profit. It was 2024 and is now a daily-use application for the non-profit. The app won an innovation award in 2025, and then was subsequently used as the basis for a grant proposal to expand the application beyond this single non-profit to all non-profits in the state. Last week we found out we won the grant and now need to start planning. There is a LOT to consider here as we expand beyond a single organization, and we are looking for a partner to help with architecting and building out the app. If you are interested, please reach out to me by sending me a direct message. Please give me an idea of the work you’ve done in the past on Bubble and the size of your team. You would be a sub-contractor on this project, so a general sense of your rates would also be useful. I don’t need a formal proposal at this point, just an expression of interest. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you have more questions, and I’m happy to provide more details via email. Look forward to hearing from folks! 5 posts - 5 participants Read full topic

title: Hiring Czech Specialist based in CZ for Make.com and AI Workflow WordPress, FAPI, Ecomail – Replies in Czech only
